THE MODEL, IN PLAIN ENGLISH

Charging activity.
Company revenue.
Your weekly illustration.

Follow the complete model

The concept connects participation in a charging business with a weekly account allocation. Driver payments are the proposed revenue source.

Your demo calculation is invested amount × weekly plan rate. It does not add a second payment for each car.

The company’s 43% participation figure is an unverified model assumption. The demo rates are illustrative, not evidence of actual returns.
